hypothesis: Replacing only the matched PyTorch gradient at each post-FF2 residual join with the exact source-captured LibNC FF2-output adjoint will reproduce all 18 source-bound named gradients while leaving the four forward distributions unchanged.
interfaces_exposed: Exact source-captured FF2-output adjoint -> matched post-FF2 residual-join backward edge
kill_condition: Retire this residual-adjoint boundary if the canonical override is nondeterministic, changes forward probabilities, fails the captured-adjoint hash, or leaves any named gradient outside 2e-6 or with a sign mismatch. No width, optimizer, loss, or tolerance sweep follows.
promotion_condition: Authorize one exact first-update parity replay only if the receipt-bound residual-join override repeats, preserves teacher probabilities, and every one of the 18 named gradients matches the LibNC receipt within 2e-6 with zero sign mismatches; a FF2-branch-only control must remain insufficient upstream.
retired_neighborhoods: No forward change, learned correction, gradient fit, parameter sweep, codec score, suffix model, or semantic event model.
title: NNCP v3.3 LibNC FF2 residual-adjoint replay
